image_title: Consolidated Financial Data - Second Quarter, Fiscal 2025
summary: This table presents the consolidated statement of comprehensive income for Infosys for the three and six months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the same periods in 2023. Key metrics include revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating profit, and net profit, with growth percentages indicating year-over-year and quarter-over-quarter changes. For the three months, revenues increased by 5.1% to ₹40,986 crore, while net profit after minority interest rose by 4.8% to ₹6,506 crore. The six-month figures show a revenue growth of 4.4% to ₹80,300 crore, with net profit after minority interest increasing by 5.9% to ₹12,874 crore. The operating margin for both periods reflects stable performance, with notable increases in other income and basic EPS.
